title: Battery module cells on a cold plate
pickerTitle: Battery module cells on a cold plate
line: A steady thermal FEA study of eight prismatic cells in one battery module, 20 W per cell, cooled from below.
description: Steady temperature of the eight prismatic cells (34 x 500 x 95 mm) of module M01 in an EV battery pack. Each cell generates 20 W, 160 W for the module. The cell bottoms are cooled through the gap filler, the cold-plate lid and the coolant, written as one effective film coefficient of 403 W/m^2/K to 25 C. Only the cells are solved; the rest of the pack is CAD context.
thumbnailAlt: Temperature of eight battery cells on a cold plate, from 301.1 K at the bottoms to 303.9 K at the tops, solved in RunMat
